high_level_description: This image captures a serene moment on a boat during what appears to be a sunset cruise. The setting is a calm body of water with a backdrop of rugged, rocky cliffs and a distant shoreline dotted with buildings, suggesting a coastal location. In the foreground, there are two individuals seated on a plush, cushioned bench. The person on the left is dressed in a white dress and has a patterned shawl draped over their shoulders. They are holding the shawl close to their chest, possibly to shield themselves from the cool evening air. Their hair is tied back, and they appear relaxed and content.
